recentItems.title: Xinhua News | China unveils measures to boost smart home consumption
recentItems.description: China on Monday unveiled an action plan to further promote smart home consumption by enriching application scenarios and expanding high-quality supply. #XinhuaNews

recentItems.title: Live: Inside China's smart salmon farm
recentItems.description: Have you ever wondered how salmon is raised? Somewhere on the eastern coast of China, there is a full-cycle system from hatchery to harvest and all the way to customer tables. With tech and care, it shows new possibilities for aquaculture in China.

recentItems.title: Spark Dialogue: What role can industry play in keeping China-EU economic ties growing?
recentItems.description:
As China-EU economic ties evolve, what role can industry play in sustaining growth?
In Spark Dialogue, Haryono Lim, President and Chairman of BASF Greater China, sits down with Xinhua's You Zhixin to discuss the company's market strategy and growth outlook, and how industrial cooperation can tap into the potential of China-EU economic ties.

recentItems.title: Vlog: What global exhibitors expect as CIFTIS 2026 wraps up
recentItems.description: Following days of exhibitions and business matchmaking,  the 2026 CIFTIS has achieved fruitful outcomes. Featuring firsthand insights from foreign exhibitors, Chinese firms and visitors, this vlog highlights their expectations for future cooperation.■

recentItems.title: Moments in Motion | Xi's New Delhi trip charts course for greater BRICS cooperation
recentItems.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping concluded a packed trip to New Delhi for the 18th #BRICS Summit.
He called on BRICS countries to be pioneers in innovation, peace, mutual learning and global governance reform, and put forward five proposals to deepen practical cooperation.
China will assume the BRICS chairmanship in 2027 and host the 19th BRICS Summit.
